t: This is Fulham Road, a long London street that carries the A304 and part of the A308. It has a couple of notable names in its past. Joseph Hansom died on this road. He was an architect working mainly in the Gothic Revival style, who invented the Hansom cab and founded the journal The Builder in 1843. The Conservative politician Alan Lennox-Boyd, later Viscount Boyd of Merton, also died here. Gerard Campbell, born in 1937, is recorded as having lived on the road.
